items.name: OXYWELD MZ 1250
items.summary: The OXYWELD MZ 1250 is a submerged arc automatic welder built to deliver superior weld quality and maximum productivity in tough applications. It ensures stable performance, low power consumption, and long-term reliability.
features: High Efficiency with Lower Power Consumption
Intelligent Protection for Over Current, Over Temperature, Over / Under Voltage, Phase Loss
Wide Welding Parameter Range for Different Applications
Digital Display for Current, Voltage and Welding Speed
items.details: The OXYWELD MZ 1250 is a submerged arc automatic welder built to deliver superior weld quality and maximum productivity in tough applications. It ensures stable performance, low power consumption, and long-term reliability. The MZ 1250 is a complete SAW welding system, including a power source and trolley. It is ideal for heavy fabrication, structural steel, shipbuilding, pressure vessels, and pipeline construction.

items.name: OXYWELD CUT 160
items.summary: The OXYWELD CUT 160 is a high-performance inverter plasma cutter designed for precise and efficient cutting of mild steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and other conductive metals.
items.details: The OXYWELD CUT 160 is a high-performance inverter plasma cutter designed for precise and efficient cutting of mild steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and other conductive metals. It has a cutting thickness of up to 25mm, an output current of 160A, and a duty cycle of 100% at 40°C.

items.name: OXYWELD MMA 400
items.summary: The OXYWELD MMA 400 is a high-performance inverter DC arc welder designed for heavy-duty welding applications, delivering superior durability, stable arc, and consistent welding performance.
items.details: The OXYWELD MMA 400 is a high-performance inverter DC arc welder designed for heavy-duty welding applications, delivering superior durability, stable arc, and consistent welding performance. It has a robust all-metal body, advanced inverter technology, and a high output of 400A.

items.name: OXYWELD NB-500E
items.summary: The OXYWELD NB-500E is a high-performance MIG/MAG/CO2 welding machine designed for heavy fabrication and industrial use, delivering smooth arc, deep penetration, and consistent weld quality.
items.details: The OXYWELD NB-500E is a high-performance MIG/MAG/CO2 welding machine designed for heavy fabrication and industrial use, delivering smooth arc, deep penetration, and consistent weld quality. It has a high output of 500A, a duty cycle of 60% at 40°C, and is ideal for heavy fabrication, structural work, plant & machinery, ship building, construction, and railway & infrastructure.

items.name: OXYWELD MIG 400
items.summary: The OXYWELD MIG 400 is a powerful inverter-based MIG/MMA welding machine built with IGBT technology for smooth, stable, and efficient welding, ideal for industrial use.
items.details: The OXYWELD MIG 400 is a powerful inverter-based MIG/MMA welding machine built with IGBT technology for smooth, stable, and efficient welding, ideal for industrial use. It has a high output of 400A, a duty cycle of 60%, and is ideal for heavy fabrication, structural work, plant & machinery, ship building, construction, automotive, and maintenance & repair.

specs.label: Dimension ( L x W x H)

items.name: OXYWELD CUT 80
items.summary: The OXYWELD CUT 80 is a plasma welding machine built for precision and performance, delivering smooth and clean cuts. It offers maximum efficiency, stability, and reliability in every job.
features: Stable arc with maximum cutting efficiency
items.details: The OXYWELD CUT 80 is designed to provide superior cut quality, high performance, and is built to last. It also features advanced technology, reliable and durable construction, and premium quality. The machine has a maximum clean cut of 14mm and a severance cut of 16mm, with a maximum output of 80A.

privacy.text:
This policy explains what personal data {name} collects through this website, why, and the choices you have.

## Who we are

{name}
{address}
Phone: {phone}
Email: {email}
GSTIN: {gstin}
CIN: {cin}

## What we collect

- **Enquiries and bookings:** the name, phone number, email address and message you send through a form on this site.
- **Technical data:** basic information your browser sends to any website, such as its type and the pages requested. Optional cookies and similar tools are used only after you allow them in the consent banner.

## Why we use it

- to answer your enquiry or booking request
- to keep the website secure and stop misuse
- to meet our legal and tax duties

We use your details only for these purposes. We do not sell personal data.

## Who we share it with

Only with those who help us run this service:
- the companies that host this website and its database
- authorities, when the law requires it

## How long we keep it

Enquiries are kept for as long as needed to answer them. After that they are deleted.

## Your rights

You can ask us for a copy of your personal data, ask us to correct or delete it, withdraw a consent you gave, and name another person to act for you. In India these rights come from the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. To use them, or to raise a grievance, write to us using the details above. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you may approach the Data Protection Board of India.

## Children

This website is not meant for children, and we do not knowingly collect their data without a parent's or guardian's consent.

## Changes

We may update this policy. The date below shows when it was last changed.

Last updated: {date}
